3D Well Viewer

How to move around

Drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom, right-drag or two-finger drag to pan. Click a wellbore to inspect it. The timeline at the bottom plays the basin through time: space plays or pauses, ← → step a year, Esc clears the selection. The chips at the top right switch layers on and off from anywhere.

About the data

Public edition. Sources: North Dakota Industrial Commission, Oil and Gas Division (well index, directional surveys and spacing units from the public GIS, monthly production reports to January 2026, formation tops and digital well logs under the Division's subscription service), FracFocus (March 2026) and USGS 3DEP. Everything shown is derived or modelled from those records: log readings appear as colour classes, cement and bond results as classes, disposal volumes as size classes, and the Dakota injection plane is a model. No NDIC logs, well files, tops tables or production or injection tables are redistributed here; the records are at dmr.nd.gov/oilgas. Free to use, no warranty.
